"""cocotb tests for crc8_block, written from interface_spec.md (not from the RTL).

Scenarios trace to the specification tags:
  CRC-RESET, CRC-INIT, CRC-POLY, CRC-ORDER, CRC-HOLD, CRC-FINAL, CRC-EMPTY.

Timing: inputs are driven just after a falling edge; the effect of the next
rising edge is checked at the following falling edge, when the design has
settled. crc is compared on every cycle.
"""
import random

import cocotb
from cocotb.clock import Clock
from cocotb.triggers import FallingEdge, RisingEdge, Timer

START = 0xFF   # spec 2: start value
POLY = 0x07    # spec 2.2: x^8 + x^2 + x + 1
XOROUT = 0xFF  # spec 2.3: final inversion


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- model ----
def model_take_byte(state, byte):
    """Spec 2.2, non-reflected: XOR the byte into the running value, then
    eight shifts, XOR-ing POLY when the bit shifted out was 1. This is the
    byte-wise form of the bit-serial rule, so the model is not a copy of the
    RTL's per-bit loop."""
    r = (state ^ byte) & 0xFF
    for _ in range(8):
        if r & 0x80:
            r = ((r << 1) ^ POLY) & 0xFF
        else:
            r = (r << 1) & 0xFF
    return r


def model_step(state, rst_n, init, valid, data):
    """One rising edge, following spec 2.1 and 2.2."""
    if not rst_n:          # CRC-RESET
        return START
    if init:               # CRC-INIT: the reload wins over a byte
        return START
    if valid:              # CRC-POLY / CRC-ORDER
        return model_take_byte(state, data)
    return state           # CRC-HOLD


def model_crc(state):
    return state ^ XOROUT  # CRC-FINAL


# ------------------------------------------------------------- harness ----
class Env:
    def __init__(self, dut):
        self.dut = dut
        self.state = None  # unknown until the first reset edge
        self.checks = 0

    async def start(self):
        cocotb.start_soon(Clock(self.dut.clk, 10, "ns").start())
        self.dut.rst_n.value = 0
        self.dut.init.value = 0
        self.dut.valid.value = 0
        self.dut.data.value = 0
        await FallingEdge(self.dut.clk)

    async def cycle(self, rst_n=1, init=0, valid=0, data=0, check=True):
        """Drive inputs for the next rising edge, update the model, then wait
        to the next falling edge and compare crc."""
        d = self.dut
        d.rst_n.value = rst_n
        d.init.value = init
        d.valid.value = valid
        d.data.value = data & 0xFF
        if self.state is None and rst_n and not init:
            nxt = None
        else:
            nxt = model_step(self.state if self.state is not None else 0,
                             rst_n, init, valid, data & 0xFF)
        await RisingEdge(d.clk)
        await FallingEdge(d.clk)
        self.state = nxt
        if check and self.state is not None:
            self.check(f"rst_n={rst_n} init={init} valid={valid} data=0x{data & 0xFF:02x}")

    def check(self, ctx=""):
        v = self.dut.crc.value
        assert v.is_resolvable, f"crc has X/Z ({v}) after {ctx}"
        got = int(v)
        exp = model_crc(self.state)
        assert got == exp, (
            f"crc mismatch after {ctx}: got 0x{got:02x}, expected 0x{exp:02x} "
            f"(model running value 0x{self.state:02x})")
        self.checks += 1

    async def reset(self, cycles=3):
        for _ in range(cycles):
            await self.cycle(rst_n=0)


# --------------------------------------------------------------- tests ----
@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_reset_and_empty(dut):
    """CRC-RESET, CRC-EMPTY: crc is 0x00 after reset; reset beats valid."""
    env = Env(dut)
    await env.start()
    await env.reset()
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0x00, "CRC-EMPTY: crc not 0x00 after reset"
    # take some bytes, then reset mid-frame with valid high: reset wins
    for b in (0x12, 0x34, 0x56):
        await env.cycle(valid=1, data=b)
    assert int(dut.crc.value) != 0x00, "frame bytes left crc at the empty value"
    await env.cycle(rst_n=0, valid=1, data=0xA5)
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0x00, "CRC-RESET: reset with valid did not reload"
    # reset with init and valid high together
    await env.cycle(valid=1, data=0x77)
    await env.cycle(rst_n=0, init=1, valid=1, data=0x3C)
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0x00
    assert env.checks > 0


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_known_single_bytes(dut):
    """CRC-POLY, CRC-ORDER, CRC-FINAL with values derived by hand from spec 2.2."""
    env = Env(dut)
    await env.start()
    await env.reset()
    await env.cycle(valid=1, data=0x00)
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0x0C, f"byte 0x00 from start: got 0x{int(dut.crc.value):02x}, expected 0x0C"
    await env.cycle(init=1)
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0x00
    await env.cycle(valid=1, data=0xFF)
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0xFF, f"byte 0xFF from start: got 0x{int(dut.crc.value):02x}, expected 0xFF"
    # bit-order sensitivity: 0x01 and 0x80 must give different check values
    await env.cycle(init=1)
    await env.cycle(valid=1, data=0x01)
    a = int(dut.crc.value)
    await env.cycle(init=1)
    await env.cycle(valid=1, data=0x80)
    b = int(dut.crc.value)
    assert a != b, "CRC-ORDER: bytes 0x01 and 0x80 gave the same crc"


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_init_priority(dut):
    """CRC-INIT: init reloads 0xFF whatever valid and data hold."""
    env = Env(dut)
    await env.start()
    await env.reset()
    for b in (0xDE, 0xAD, 0xBE, 0xEF):
        await env.cycle(valid=1, data=b)
    await env.cycle(init=1, valid=1, data=0x5A)
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0x00, "CRC-INIT: byte taken at the same edge as init"
    await env.cycle(init=1, valid=0, data=0x99)
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0x00
    # several consecutive init+valid cycles
    for b in (0x01, 0x02, 0x03):
        await env.cycle(init=1, valid=1, data=b)
        assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0x00
    # first byte after init is taken from the start value
    await env.cycle(valid=1, data=0x00)
    assert int(dut.crc.value) == 0x0C


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_hold(dut):
    """CRC-HOLD: with valid and init low the value does not change, whatever data does."""
    env = Env(dut)
    await env.start()
    await env.reset()
    for b in (0x10, 0x20, 0x30):
        await env.cycle(valid=1, data=b)
    held = int(dut.crc.value)
    for b in (0x00, 0xFF, 0x55, 0xAA, 0x0F):
        await env.cycle(valid=0, data=b)
        assert int(dut.crc.value) == held, "CRC-HOLD: value changed with valid low"
    await env.cycle(valid=1, data=0x40)
    assert int(dut.crc.value) != held or env.state == model_take_byte(env.state, 0)
    assert env.checks >= 8


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=2, timeout_unit="ms")
async def test_random_frames(dut):
    """Seeded random frames with idle gaps, init (alone and with valid) and
    mid-frame resets; crc compared against the model on every cycle."""
    seed = random.getrandbits(32)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    dut._log.info("random_frames seed=%d", seed)
    env = Env(dut)
    await env.start()
    await env.reset()
    corners = {"init_with_valid": 0, "reset_mid_frame": 0, "hold": 0,
               "bytes": 0, "long_frame": 0}
    for _ in range(40):
        await env.cycle(init=1, valid=rng.random() < 0.5, data=rng.getrandbits(8))
        n = rng.randint(1, 24)
        if n >= 16:
            corners["long_frame"] += 1
        for _ in range(n):
            r = rng.random()
            if r < 0.03:
                await env.cycle(rst_n=0, valid=1, data=rng.getrandbits(8))
                corners["reset_mid_frame"] += 1
            elif r < 0.08:
                await env.cycle(init=1, valid=1, data=rng.getrandbits(8))
                corners["init_with_valid"] += 1
            elif r < 0.25:
                await env.cycle(valid=0, data=rng.getrandbits(8))
                corners["hold"] += 1
            else:
                await env.cycle(valid=1, data=rng.getrandbits(8))
                corners["bytes"] += 1
    dut._log.info("corners=%s checks=%d", corners, env.checks)
    for name, count in corners.items():
        assert count > 0, f"random phase never reached corner {name} (seed={seed})"
    assert env.checks > 200
=== END FILE ===
